x: Jim Heathfield was second in the 440 and Terry Bateman won the high jump. Tea and sandwiches were provided afterwards by our hosts, prominent among whom were our old friends Syd Jarlett and Bill Speaight..
Bill Speaight, a veteran and second claim member was an easy winner of the handicap, with Len Rolls another vet. second and young Gowar, a lad who looks about 20 but is only 16, 3rd.
